detail: Full summary: every session on this machine serves this repo's dist/ via the npm link — running `npm run build` in the main checkout on a v3 branch would make v3 server code serve v2 stores in other sessions. Plan assumption A11: no dist builds in the main checkout during the programme; builds in worktrees/scratch; v3 must refuse to serve a v2 store without explicit migrate.
